title: Velista: a basket row records buys, and a detailed view of its lists
lede: Velista plans 0201 (the row sheet records what was bought for each list) and 0200 (a detailed view, rows/:rowKey/lists, holds each list's ask and the change of product), with backend 0273 behind the first. They ship together, so every frame draws the end state of both. Each board shows Day in English on the left and Night in Spanish on the right; the Spanish words are the proposed es keys. The row sheet gains a heading and one text button where "Change for all lists" was; the detailed view is a sheet like the shop picker, with the chevron beside its title. No container, no tint, no banner. Round 3 applies the owner's review: layout A and colours A are chosen, so their choice boards are gone; the detailed view opens on the product (picture, name, brand and size, price) with "Change for all lists" under it; each list shows its own product on one line, in amber when it is not the product at the top; a list whose ask the reader may not change keeps a disabled stepper, and pressing it explains why; the rows' heading says they hold what each list asks for. One board is still a choice, lettered, default A. The board marked Today is drawn from the source on dev. Generated from the committed *.dc.html artboards and the notes in canvas.json.

annotations.text:
TODAY.
Each list has the swap icon in a bordered square, which changes the product of that list's line, and a stepper that changes what the list asks for.
Drawn from row-entries and the stepper on dev, not photographed: the staging account no longer signs in.

0201 TARGET STATES 2, 5, 6, 8; 0200 TARGET STATE 2. COLOURS A, CHOSEN.
The heading says What you bought. Each stepper counts what this basket bought for that list in this trip; each name carries the list's ask. Básicos asks 2, has 2: its number is green. Cocina asks 1, has 2: amber. Only the number takes the colour.
Lists and amounts, at the right of the heading, opens the detailed view.

0200 SPECS 1; 0201 SPECS 6. OPEN QUESTION.
Drawn by the plan's rule: a guest whose lists allow no change of ask or product sees no Lists and amounts. Round 3 shows a disabled stepper for a list the reader may not change, so the view could now be shown to a guest too, all disabled. Hide it (as drawn) or show it?

0200 TARGET STATES 1, 3. LAYOUT A.
The view opens on the product: picture, name, brand and size, price, as the compact product card draws them. Only Compra semanal may change its product, so no Change for all lists.
The rows' heading, What each list asks for, says the steppers are the lists' asks. Bought 2 of 3 is plain text. Each list shows its product on one line; Change sits only where it is allowed.
Every picture is a button that opens the picture viewer, as in the app.

0200 TARGET STATE 4.
Two lists may change their product, so Change for all lists sits under the product, in the block it changes, not in the heading.
Básicos takes Puleva: its product line is amber, because it is not the product at the top (the row's product, Hacendado). Open question: is Change at the end of an amber line clear enough? Choice B below avoids two ambers on one line.

RULING 3. WORDS PROPOSED.
Another list keeps its stepper, drawn as the app's disabled stepper (both ends at 35%). A press opens the note popover (anchored-popover, 280 px) over the capsule; a press anywhere closes it.
Proposed for a list in a group you are not in: This list belongs to a group you are not in. Only its members can change what it asks for.
For a list of your group you may not change (a guest): Only members of Casa can change what this list asks for. / Solo los miembros de Casa pueden cambiar lo que pide esta lista.

0201 TARGET STATE 5.
The name gives way first: Compra semanal de la… · 1,5 kg. The ask is never cut. The line under it is cut on its own.
A product by weight shows the ask in its exact form with the unit, and the stepper the figure over kg, as the sheet stepper already does.

0200 FRAME 4.
The list name and its zone · line are cut; Bought 0,5 of 1,5 kg and the stepper are not. A product name that long wraps to two lines in the block and is cut on a list's line, where its brand never is.
A product with no photo draws the app's product icon on the sunken fill, and is not a button.

0201 TARGET STATE 7.
Add it to another list becomes Bought for another list. Its steppers start at 0 and a press up records a buy for that list. Despensa is stepped to 1.
When the answer comes back, Despensa becomes a list of the row, Despensa · 0, with its 1 in amber, and leaves this section.

CHOICE, THE WAY TO CHANGE ONE LIST'S PRODUCT. WHICH LETTER?
The whole product line is the control where the list may change it (44 px tall); the picture inside it opens the photo.
A: the word Change at its end, in the app's quiet action amber. B: a chevron, quieter, and no amber beside an amber product name. A list that may not change shows neither.
